experiment_data.hypothesis: Per-layer KL K=4 (4 active layers per step) PPL eval at 30% uniform sparsity. Tests whether K=4 reduces train-inference mismatch vs K=1 (PPL=9.05). If PPL < 9.05, the mask-pattern-discovery story needs softening (K=4 fixes mismatch). If PPL ≈ 9.05, mismatch is not the dominant PPL factor. If PPL > 9.05, K=4 introduces new dynamics. Result determines C1 narrative.
